system_prompt: You are an enterprise financial analyst assistant. Provide accurate, data-driven responses based on the provided context. Always cite source documents.
user_input: What were the Q3 2025 revenue trends for the APAC region?

retrieval_documents.content: APAC Q3 2025 Revenue Report: Total revenue reached $4.2B, representing a 12.3% YoY increase. Key growth drivers included cloud services (+18.4%) and AI platform licensing (+34.2%). Japan and India led regional performance with $1.1B and $890M respectively.

Global Revenue Summary FY2025: Enterprise AI platform adoption accelerated across all regions. APAC showed strongest sequential growth at 4.7% QoQ, driven by new enterprise contracts in financial services and healthcare verticals.
